articles.title: From Ruffled Socks to Centre Court: Alex Eala's Big Wimbledon Win!
articles.summary: Imagine beating the defending champion on tennis's most famous court! Alex Eala did just that, stunning Iga Swiatek at Wimbledon. She's the first player from the Philippines to reach the fourth round of a Grand Slam—and she dedicated the win to "all the girls with ruffled socks and chubby cheeks."

articles.title: How Teens Invented Cool: From Rock 'n' Roll to Emojis!
articles.summary: Did you know teenagers weren't always a thing? The U.S. basically invented them in the 1950s, and ever since, teens have been shaping pop culture. From transistor radios to malls to beepers, each generation found its own way to be awesome—and change the world.

articles.title: The Secret Irish Army That Helped Win the American Revolution!
articles.summary: Did you know that up to half of George Washington's soldiers were Irish? These immigrants had fled British oppression in Ireland, so they were extra motivated to fight for American freedom. One Irish captain, John Barry, became known as the "father of the U.S. Navy."
